Sub: Problem in CEPS software for calculation of pension for new
entrants under para 12(2) of EPS 95 — Reg

This is regarding incorrect pension calculation calculated by CEPS software
developed by NIC for new entrants under Para 12(2) of EPS-95.

2. The problem has been examined at HQ level and the following ways are
suggested to carryout necessary changes/modification.

= Calculate Monthly member pension amount manually

= Generate final PPO as per normal procedure

* In case of any difference in Monthly member pension amount calculated by
the software go to [PPO] module option no.2

* Make changes in the Original Monthly pension amount and other related
changes respectively

= Take revised PPO print through [PPO] module vide option No.5

3. It is also intimated that the correctness of the data entered through the PPO

module vide option no.2, should be ensured by Incharge of Pension Division and before
issuing the final PPO, the amount of pension and other arrears amounts may be checked

by the concerned officer.
fiat pith re a

(Col.S.S. Dhan har
